research_result.description: Smartsheet is a work management and productivity platform that provides REST APIs, SDKs, and an MCP server for managing sheets, rows, columns, reports, and automated workflows.
research_result.credential_requirements: Generating API access tokens requires a Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management plan. Access tokens can be generated directly in the Smartsheet UI under Personal Settings > API Access. Applications requiring user authorization via OAuth 2.0 must register for Developer Tools using a licensed Smartsheet account on a Business plan or higher.

evidence.claim: The Smartsheet API is restricted to paid plans including Business and Enterprise.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Smartsheet API is restricted to users on Business and Enterprise plans

evidence.claim: Smartsheet supports OAuth 2.0 and HTTP Bearer tokens for API authorization.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Each API request requires passing in an access token as the `Bearer` value in your authorization header.

evidence.claim: Smartsheet provides a REST API following standard resource-oriented conventions and HTTP verbs.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The REST URL structure follows typical resource-oriented conventions.

evidence.claim: Smartsheet provides an official MCP server for connecting AI tools to Smartsheet data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Unlock the power of AI by connecting Smartsheet with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI clients through the Smartsheet MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.
